title: Neuromatch Academy: Computational Neuroscience (course book)
description: Open course book for the Neuromatch Academy computational neuroscience summer school: optional refresher days (Python, linear algebra, calculus, statistics, neuro video series), then fifteen course days in four modules (Intro to Modeling; Machine Learning; Dynamical Systems; Stochastic Processes), each day built from an intro, two to six Jupyter tutorials with videos and coding exercises, an outro and a day summary, plus a project booklet.
rightsNotes: Content licence (recorded separately from code): 'The contents of this repository are shared under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License' — repository README and the footer of every book page opened on 2026-10-30; LICENSE.md is the CC BY 4.0 legal text.

Code licence: 'Software elements are additionally licensed under the BSD (3-Clause) License' — repository README; LICENSE-CODE.md read 2026-10-30. The README adds that derivative works may use the licence more appropriate to the context.

Datasets loaded inside tutorials carry their own terms: W1D3 Tutorial 1 states its retinal ganglion cell data (Uzzell and Chichilnisky 2004) is 'provided for tutorial purposes only'; W1D1 and W1D3 acknowledge Steinmetz et al. (2019) for the shared data subset. Corniversity links to the tutorials and does not redistribute these datasets; the Corniversity laboratory uses its own clearly labelled synthetic data.
Attribution: Neuromatch Academy is credited on every unit that uses its tutorials; Corniversity is not affiliated with Neuromatch and issues no Neuromatch certificate.
